## Company-Level OKRs

### O1: Build the most trusted content intelligence platform for creators on X
- KR1.1: Reach 5,000 MAU (Baseline: 0 → Target: 5,000)
- KR1.2: Achieve 4.5+ star average rating across G2, Capterra, and Product Hunt (Baseline: 0 → Target: 4.5)
- KR1.3: Deliver 87% scoring accuracy maintained across 100K+ analyzed posts (Baseline: 87% → Target: 87%+)
- KR1.4: Achieve 12% free-to-paid conversion rate (Baseline: 0 → Target: 12%)

### O2: Establish product-market fit through measurable creator success
- KR2.1: Users who score 10+ posts see 3x engagement improvement within 30 days (Baseline: N/A → Target: 3x)
- KR2.2: Achieve 85% weekly retention for active scorers (Baseline: N/A → Target: 85%)
- KR2.3: Generate $15,000 MRR by end of Q3 (Baseline: $0 → Target: $15,000)
- KR2.4: Achieve NPS score of 40+ (Baseline: N/A → Target: 40+)

### O3: Build a world-class engineering foundation for scale
- KR3.1: Achieve 99.9% API uptime (SLO) (Baseline: N/A → Target: 99.9%)
- KR3.2: Complete SOC 2 Type I certification (Baseline: Not started → Target: Certified)
- KR3.3: Reduce p99 scoring latency to <500ms (Baseline: ~3s → Target: <500ms)
- KR3.4: Ship zero critical security incidents (Baseline: 0 → Target: 0)

## Engineering Team OKRs

### O1: Deliver a fast, reliable, and secure scoring engine
- KR1.1: Reduce p99 scoring latency from ~3s to <500ms (Company KR3.3 alignment)
- KR1.2: Deploy multi-region failover with <30s recovery time (Baseline: Single region → Target: Multi-region)
- KR1.3: Complete 100% test coverage on scoring engine (Baseline: ~0% → Target: 100%)
- KR1.4: Pass external penetration test with zero critical findings (Company KR3.4 alignment)

### O2: Scale infrastructure to support 10x user growth
- KR2.1: Autoscaling enabled for all services — handle 5,000 concurrent users (Baseline: Manual → Target: Auto, 5K)
- KR2.2: Implement CDN caching reducing origin load by 60% (Baseline: 0% → Target: 60%)
- KR2.3: Reduce infrastructure cost per user to <$0.50/month (Baseline: N/A → Target: <$0.50)
